mainQuestExcel.description: You hear of a mysterious store called the Bantan Sango Detective Agency in Inazuma...

dialogs.text: It's about time...
Oh-ho, welcome. Are you having a problem?
Hm, I see. You don't have any problems... you just want to wander around...
Well, this is the humble Bantan Sango Detective Agency. And I am a detective.
Might I ask your name?
My name is Sango, and I'm the president of this detective agency.
Well, I call myself the president, but this detective agency only has two employees.
So, is this the first time you've seen a detective agency?
What do you do as a detective?
Huh, that's a good question. From the perspective of the general public, detective work must seem rather special and mysterious.
But as far as I'm concerned, it's like any other work. It pays the bills.
That said, the work is a little unusual sometimes and the clients are occasionally noteworthy individuals...
But otherwise, it's a way to make a living just like any other.
I didn't meet a single detective in all my time in Mondstadt.
Mondstadt... Oh, you mean Mondstadt City. I've heard of it.
The two most famous things about Mondstadt are its wine and its freedom.
Hahaha, those two things really compliment each other... I suspect that if there were detectives in Mondstadt, their business would be booming every day.
I've never seen a detective in Liyue.
Liyue doesn't really need detectives. I've heard about how much they value contracts there.
Besides, they have the Millelith, who quickly solve problems large and small...
Even if there were a detective agency, I suspect it would have to close down due of lack of business.
I've only met one legal adviser...
Legal advisers? Ah... I've heard that... they're pretty difficult to deal with.
I suspect that what these people do is complicate simple problems. They take something simple and make it complex and then turn it into confusing contracts.
I hope I never meet one.
Now, you look kinda interested in the detective agency.
Can I be a detective?
You want to be a detective? It's a tough job. Don't let fiction fool you.
There are no thrilling chases or life and death decisions during cases.
Real detective work is more along the lines of files that fill an entire room, muddy mountain roads, and suspects who leave nary a trace...
Maybe it's hard to understand from me just describing it... I happen to have a small case open. Why don't you get some personal experience in?
My assistant, Ryuuji, went out to collect clues a little while ago and still hasn't returned.
He should have collected enough clues by now, though.
Could you go get Ryuuji for me?
He isn't in any danger, is he?
I went over everything with him. Even if something unexpected happens, he should be able to handle it.
What I'm more concerned about is whether he has found what I'm looking for or not.
So I'll wait for your news and of course, you will get paid. Plus... it's a chance for you to experience the life of a detective.
There couldn't have been an accident, right?...
Not likely. I covered everything with him.
Even if something unexpected happens...
With his skills, he should be able to take care of himself.
What I'm more concerned about is whether he has found what I'm looking for or not.
It sounds like quite a hassle...
That's right. Detectives are professional problem solvers.
Thrilling chases and life and death decisions are just for the novels.
Real detective work is more along the lines of files that fill an entire room, muddy mountain roads, and suspects who leave nary a trace...
But the novels do get one thing right: detectives always have a variety of assistants.
So you also have assistants, then?
Of course. Mine is busy outside, as a matter of fact. So now... I'm in need of another one.
Would you be willing to help me?
So I'll wait for your news and of course, you will get paid. Plus... it's a chance for you to experience the life of a detective.
Aren't you worried about your assistant?
He's very skilled and tough. No need to worry about him.
After all, he used to be a Doushin.
Why didn't you go with your assistant?
Well, how should I put it... we both have our roles to play.
He is responsible for gathering evidence and clues and I'm responsible for analyzing them to uncover the truth.
A reasonable division of labor is the basis for an agency to function well.
So I'll wait for your news and of course, you will get paid. Plus... it's a chance for you to experience the life of a detective.
Aren't you worried about your assistant?
He's very skilled and tough. No need to worry about him.
After all, he used to be a Doushin.
Why didn't you go with your assistant?
Well, how should I put it... we both have our roles to play.
He is responsible for gathering evidence and clues and I'm responsible for analyzing them to uncover the truth.
A reasonable division of labor is the basis for an agency to function well.
Ah. You're the assistant Sango was talking about?
You were expecting me?
Well... not really. It's just Sango said that someone was coming to help out.
Hey, what are you guys doing?
Are those Treasure Hoarders? Why are they so close to the city...
Ryuuji, why are you here? And this suspicious outlander...
You talking to me?
Yeah, I mean, you're the only outlander here.
Alright, let's not be overly sensitive. Ryuuji, what brings you here?
I was following a suspicious person here according to Sango's instructions, but then I bumped into some Treasure Hoarders.
The Traveler is an assistant invited by Sango. We just drove the Treasure Hoarders off together.
I see... But why would there be Treasure Hoarders nearby?
Ryuuji, you just mentioned you were following some suspicious people... Hey! Did you follow the Treasure Hoarders from inside the city?
I think so. Sango's been dealing with a serial theft case. I've been searching the city based on her hunch.
Shortly after, I spotted a suspicious man near Hanamizaka. He left in a panic after I just asked a couple of questions.
I followed him out of town, and you all know what happened after that.
Hmm... Ryuuji, how are you suddenly so good at talking? You weren't much of a talker before.
Working with Sango makes you a good speaker, I see, eh?
What are you two doing here?
Andou said that there was a suspicious blonde outlander wandering around town, so we came to have a look.
That's why we followed you. I didn't know that you were Sango's assistant. Sorry for the misunderstanding.
Ah... Ryuuji, you said that you found the suspicious person in the city, right?
That's correct.
How dare they try to sink their paws into our city...
Yeah. But when it's only... us...
(Why is he suddenly at a loss for words?)
Hmm... Still, we can only drive off one or two Treasure Hoarders by ourselves. To get rid of them completely, we have to rely on you guys.
If you want to see the evidence, you can go to the city and look for Sango. She will explain everything to you in detail.
Hmm... Amano, let's go look for Sango. If there really are Treasure Hoarders in town, we should do something.
Yes... yes, that's right! Let's go find Sango. Ryuuji, you should head back soon too.
...Phew.
Let's head back.
The things that you just said...
Sango asked me to say them.
We've done our part, so let's go back.
(He seems to have forgotten what he was saying...)
So, you also followed a suspicious person here?
You can say that. Albeit the suspicious person we were pursuing was actually you. Ahem.
Andou said that there was a suspicious blonde outlander wandering around town, so we came to have a look.
That's why we followed you. I didn't know that you were Sango's assistant. Sorry for the misunderstanding.
I'm Sango's assistant.
Sango's assistant? Now that sounds even more suspicious...
So I'll wait for your news and of course, you will get paid. Plus... it's a chance for you to experience the life of a detective.
Aren't you worried about your assistant?
He's very skilled and tough. No need to worry about him.
After all, he used to be a Doushin.
Why didn't you go with your assistant?
Well, how should I put it... we both have our roles to play.
He is responsible for gathering evidence and clues and I'm responsible for analyzing them to uncover the truth.
A reasonable division of labor is the basis for an agency to function well.
Miss Sango, is this true?
Are the serial burglaries in the city really the work of Treasure Hoarders?
That's for certain. I've just shown you the evidence, I'm sure that with your professional instincts, you should have already figured that out.
The Treasure Hoarders... how dare they! They have no regard for us at all, do they?
Amano! Let's go back and report this.
We must step up our patrols. We can't give these jerks a single opening.
Miss Sango, may we borrow the evidence? We need it to convince the higher-ups to take action.
No problem, go ahead. It's not within our agency's ability to handle the Treasure Hoarders. We'll have to rely on the police for that.
Please rest assured! We shan't let any of the Treasure Hoarders off!
Thank you. Now... everything should be ready.
Ready?
Yes. The two Doushin from the police station are important "assistants" in closing this case.
After the two Doushin step up their patrols, the Treasure Hoarders in town will be on high alert.
Ryuuji, you fought with the Treasure Hoarders at the place I asked you to go to, right?
Yes. Traveler and I fought them off.
Hmm... that's good. You've probably made quite a splash.
All we have to do now is wait for our opportunity.
Thank you for your help, Traveler. Here's your remuneration.
I'm not sure I've done anything to help...
Don't say that. You attracted Andou's attention by being an outlander, and got him and Amano to chase you and rendezvous with Ryuuji...
Now they've seen the threat of the Treasure Hoarders with their own eyes, which will cause them to step up patrols in the city...
That was all something only you could have done.
After all, it was more effective to let the Doushin witness the Treasure Hoarders themselves than for me to just tell them.
Anyway, take these. Who knows? Maybe I'll need your help again some time.
What are you planning?
I am a detective, so I plan on solving the case, of course.
The two Doushin from the police station are important "assistants" in closing that case.
